dimensions.summary: Repository providers emit admitted facts into the single canonical Graph composition path.
Inventory, provider facts, preview views and review context slices have independent fixed ceilings.
Repository work is bounded, worker-capable and query profiles remain below their declared local budgets.
Default execution denies network, process and credentials while path, symlink, parser, budget and publication boundaries fail closed.
Artifacts and evidence contain portable relative locators; Git remotes, config, credentials and machine-local paths are excluded.
Local checks pass; retained same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G4 evidence remains required.
A packed consumer builds repositories, queries, slices and publishes without the central CLI runtime.
Real multi-language fixtures, fixed views and slices preserve canonical identity, proof and stable ordering.
Structural extraction, preview and slice wire contracts are versioned candidates in the content-addressed catalog.
Unsupported languages, dynamic routes, unreadable inputs, truncation and unavailable Git state remain explicit quality evidence.
Providers, adapters, CLI, persistence and projections have package-owned contract, fixture and adversarial tests.
The package remains private and packed output excludes source, tests, governance, scripts, maps and internal documents.

checks.evidence: Package-owned build, contract, test, runtime, packed-consumer and admission gates pass locally.
An isolated installed tarball exercises preview, query, view, slice and explicit publication.
Same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G4 repository preview evidence is not yet retained.

remainingRisks: The signed candidate still requires retained Linux, Windows and macOS repository preview evidence.
YAML contract semantics and dynamic language constructs remain explicitly unparsed rather than guessed.
Workspace composition, generic projections and generic graph slices remain G5 work.
Rust, native and WASM acceleration remain prohibited until G6 measurements justify a parity-checked adapter.
Central CLI shadow parity and replacement remain prohibited until G8.

approval.rule: A signed checkpoint plus retained same-commit Linux, Windows and macOS G4 evidence authorizes G5 only.
